# LawStaff Group

> LawStaff Group is a legal staffing company, powered by NorthPoint, placing attorneys, paralegals, contract administrators and legal assistants with law firms and legal departments in fractional, contract, temporary, temp-to-hire and direct-hire roles since 2003. Based in Alpharetta (metro Atlanta), GA.

## Four ways to staff
- Fractional: a set number of hours each week or month, ongoing (for example a fractional general counsel, or a paralegal for one practice group). The professional works on LawStaff Group's payroll.
- Contract and temp: full or part time with an end date, such as a trial, a leave, a backlog or a project. On LawStaff Group's payroll.
- Temp-to-hire: starts on LawStaff Group's payroll so the employer can see the work before making an offer.
- Direct hire: a permanent hire on the employer's payroll from day one, backed by a replacement guarantee.
- Billing: on fractional, contract and temp-to-hire placements, the employer pays one hourly rate for approved hours, covering the professional's pay and LawStaff Group's fee, quoted for every candidate before interviews. LawStaff Group handles payroll, employer taxes, workers' compensation, unemployment and general liability coverage. Candidates never pay a fee.
- Screening: a LawStaff recruiter interviews, tests and reference-checks every candidate, confirms bar admissions for attorneys, and asks a screening questionnaire built with the employer. Every candidate presented has a recorded video interview.
- Independence: LawStaff Group never directs an attorney's legal work or professional judgment and never takes a share of legal fees. LawStaff Group is a legal staffing company, not a law firm, and does not provide legal advice.

## Who we place
Attorneys, paralegals, legal secretaries, legal administrators, litigation support, legal office services, legal nurse consultants and legal IT professionals.

## Hiring solutions
- Temporary placement: coverage for absences, special projects, leave and trial preparation. We handle payroll, workers' compensation, employer taxes and unemployment insurance.
- Temp-to-hire: evaluate a candidate's work before hiring full time.
- Direct hire: pre-screened candidates matched to your job description, backed by a replacement guarantee.
- Payroll services: we payroll a candidate you have already found.

## How we work
We interview every candidate, qualify their skills, test their abilities and check references. Clients are only presented with pre-screened, qualified candidates.

Customized screening questionnaires: for every search we build a screening questionnaire with the client's input, and the candidate's answers are submitted with every résumé, saving clients review time.

Video introductions: every candidate is invited to film an optional video introduction, so clients can see how they communicate before the first call.
